Class JsonColumnConverter<T>

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.entity.JsonColumnConverter<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.persistence.AttributeConverter<T,String>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DraftApplication.CourseInterestsConverter, DraftApplication.LevelsConverter, DraftApplication.PriorCourseworkConverter
public abstract class JsonColumnConverter<T> extends Object implements jakarta.persistence.AttributeConverter<T,String>
Stores a collection as JSON text in one column.

Used by DraftApplication, whose collections (prior coursework, topic ratings, interest levels, course interests) are only ever read and written whole, so they need no tables of their own. A null or blank column reads back as an empty collection, never as null, so the form always has something to iterate over.
